chunks: Tell: I am forbidden to worship those you invoke apart from God. Tell: I will not follow your desires. If I do, I shall be lost and not be one of those who follow the right path.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about following the desires of polytheists?
ai.summary: In the context of the Meccan period, this verse establishes the Prophet's absolute adherence to divine revelation over the prevailing cultural norms of the Quraysh, a theme central to Shia understanding of the Prophet's infallibility (Ismah) in conveying the message. It serves as a definitive rejection of blind imitation (Taqlid) of ancestral traditions, linking the rejection of idolatry directly to the rejection of subjective whims (Ahwa').
